architectureCompliance.dataSeparation: COMPLIANT - New endpoints use SurrealDB as source of truth, no direct Redis access in analytics layer
architectureCompliance.caching: COMPLIANT - RTK Query provides client-side caching, backend uses SurrealDB queries without cache-aside pattern for execution details (always fresh)
architectureCompliance.apiDesign: COMPLIANT - RESTful endpoints with clear resource paths (/analytics/executions, /analytics/executions/{id}), standard query parameters
architectureCompliance.componentDesign: COMPLIANT - React functional components with hooks, Material-UI for consistency, separation of concerns (ExecutionRow as separate concern)
architectureCompliance.errorHandling: COMPLIANT - HTTP exceptions with appropriate status codes (404 for not found, 500 for server errors), try-catch blocks with logging

backend: GET /analytics/executions: N+1 query issue for task_count (queries task_execution for each execution). Optimization: Add task_count column to activity_executions table, updated by PATCH /v2/activities/tasks
GET /analytics/executions/{id}: 3 separate queries (execution, tasks, content). Optimization: Use SurrealDB FETCH to join in single query
Pagination: Effective for large datasets. Offset-based pagination scales to thousands of executions.
frontend: ExecutionRow: Lazy loading of details reduces initial page load. Optimization: Implement virtualized scrolling for >100 rows
ActivityHistory: Client-side filtering would improve UX. Current implementation: server-side only. Optimization: Add client-side filter for instant feedback
RTK Query caching: Reduces redundant API calls. Cache invalidation strategy needed for real-time updates (WebSocket or polling)

securityConsiderations: No authentication/authorization implemented in new endpoints - relies on existing FastAPI middleware
No input sanitization for query parameters - SurrealDB parameterized queries prevent SQL injection
No rate limiting on analytics endpoints - relies on existing API gateway rate limits
Execution details may contain sensitive data in error_message field - consider redaction for non-admin users
